note: Seed pattern library (C8 data). DRAFT: written from the general crash-type diagnosis lists in HSM (1st ed.) Part B, Chapter 6. Not yet reviewed or approved by the user; findings label every entry as draft until it is (CLAUDE.md: nothing is learned without user approval).

type_broadside.title: Right-angle (broadside) collisions
type_broadside.ref: HSM Part B, Ch. 6 diagnosis: right-angle collisions
type_broadside.verify: Check signal visibility, change and clearance intervals, approach speeds and sight distance on each approach.

type_rear_end.title: Rear-end collisions
type_rear_end.ref: HSM Part B, Ch. 6 diagnosis: rear-end collisions
factors: Unexpected lane changes or sudden stops
type_rear_end.verify: Observe queues and stopping behavior at peak; check signal visibility, timing and nearby driveways.

type_side_swipe.title: Sideswipe collisions
type_side_swipe.ref: HSM Part B, Ch. 6 diagnosis: sideswipe collisions
factors: Unclear lane assignment or lane drops
Inadequate lane-use signs and pavement markings
type_side_swipe.verify: Check lane widths, lane-use signs and markings, lane drops and driveway weaving on the approach.

type_head_on.title: Head-on collisions
type_head_on.ref: HSM Part B, Ch. 6 diagnosis: head-on collisions
type_head_on.verify: Check centerline markings, lane widths, median treatment and speeds.

type_hit_object.title: Fixed-object collisions
type_hit_object.ref: HSM Part B, Ch. 6 diagnosis: fixed-object collisions
factors: Obstruction in or near the roadway
type_hit_object.verify: Inventory roadside objects and clear zone; check delineation and lighting.

type_vehicle_pedestrian.title: Vehicle–pedestrian collisions
type_vehicle_pedestrian.ref: HSM Part B, Ch. 6 diagnosis: pedestrian collisions
factors: Inadequate signal phasing or crossing time
type_vehicle_pedestrian.verify: Observe crossings; check crosswalks, signal phasing and crossing time, lighting and sight lines.

ped.title: Pedestrian crashes
ped.ref: HSM Part B, Ch. 6 diagnosis: pedestrian collisions
factors: Inadequate signal phasing or crossing time
ped.verify: Observe crossings; check crosswalks, signal phasing and crossing time, lighting and sight lines.

bike.title: Bicycle crashes
bike.ref: HSM Part B, Ch. 6 diagnosis: bicycle collisions
bike.verify: Check bike facilities, driveway conflicts and sight lines along the location.

dark.title: Nighttime crashes under street lights
dark.ref: HSM Part B, Ch. 6 diagnosis: nighttime collisions
dark.verify: Night visit: measure lighting, check delineation, sign and marking retroreflectivity.

wet.title: Wet-pavement crashes
wet.ref: HSM Part B, Ch. 6 diagnosis: wet-pavement collisions
wet.verify: Check pavement friction, drainage and ponding locations.

dark_unlit.title: Nighttime crashes without working street lights
dark_unlit.ref: HSM Part B, Ch. 6 diagnosis: nighttime collisions
factors: No street lighting, or lights not functioning
Poor visibility of pedestrians and signs
dark_unlit.verify: Night visit: confirm which lights are missing or out, and check delineation and sign retroreflectivity.
